verdict.rationale: Stripe publishes official SDKs for AI-native building. The stripe/ai repo is described as "a collection of SDKs to help you integrate Stripe with LLMs and agent frameworks" and includes @stripe/ai-sdk, @stripe/token-meter, and the still-published @stripe/agent-toolkit. The core `stripe` npm package appears in the MPP quickstart alongside the official mppx SDK, and the published OpenAPI files can be used to generate client libraries. Monthly API releases are documented as backward-compatible, so SDK-based builds can upgrade safely. Missing for 10: documentation of the core server-side SDKs and their language coverage (e.g. Python, Ruby, Go, Java), SDK reference docs or versioning policy, and independent hands-on corroboration of the SDK experience.
